sources.title: OrionLLM/LRM-3.2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: 1. Introduction We're introducing LRM-3.2, a reasoning model built around a single idea: thinking should be fast, direct, and dense — not padded. LRM-3.2 keeps the full depth of chain-of-thought reasoning while stripping out the narrative scaffolding that most models use to fill space.
